% Known-good unit-bound key against ak_unit.json: every declared answer_unit
% is printed inside its own problem's box. Exercises the unit shapes the
% matcher must accept: plain \text{ft}, \text{m}, the split \text{cm}^2 form
% (a "cm" that is a sub-sequence of the declared "cm^2" is declared, not
% decoration), a two-word \text{square units}, and the degrees-via-^\circ
% alias with no \text at all.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\begin{document}
\section*{Answer Key}
\begin{enumerate}
  \item $9\tan(35^\circ) \approx 6.30$. \quad $\boxed{6.30\ \text{ft}}$
  \item $d = \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = 5$. \quad $\boxed{5\ \text{m}}$
  \item Shoelace area. \quad $\boxed{17\ \text{cm}^2}$
  \item Half of $4 \cdot 3$. \quad $\boxed{6\ \text{square units}}$
  \item Law of cosines. \quad $\boxed{48.19^\circ}$
\end{enumerate}
\end{document}
